points.description: States that sizeof returns the size in bytes of its operand (the memory size of the operand, e.g. a variable or type). Equivalent wording such as 'the number of bytes occupied by the operand' earns the mark.

rubric.notes: The model answer is a single idea: sizeof returns the byte size of its operand. Full marks require the student to state that the result is a size in bytes of the operand. Any answer that gives a different quantity (value, address, element count) is wrong and loses marks; no partial credit is given for vague answers such as 'it gives the size' without saying what it is measured in or of what.
